sentences.text: `` Victoria '' is a song by New Zealand rock band The Exponents from their 1982 album Prayers Be Answered and their debut single .	Prayers Be Answered	Prayers Be Answered	New Zealand	New Zealand	The Exponents	The Exponents
Released in 1982 it reached Number 6 on the New Zealand singles chart .	New Zealand	New Zealand
